propositions: Completion verifier accepted a mistagged CODE-VERIFIABLE acceptance criterion marked [operator-attested] despite repository-resident proof existing (test file path), allowing laundering of the attestation anti-pattern.

Plan-review layered defenses failed: evidence-kind criterion returned no finding despite AC text citing exact repo paths (nondeterministic LLM miss); det_measurement_provenance detected missing provenance: lines but wired as ADVISORY, not BLOCKING.

A deterministic pre-close guard (laundering_gaps detector + txn.ensure_attested_items_valid) must reject [operator-attested] ACs whose own block cites exact repository paths/symbols before the completion verifier runs.

The close-path guard distinguishes test-shaped citations (tests/, test_*, pytest ::node) which always fire as laundering, from other repo citations which fire only when evidence-introducing words precede them, to avoid false positives on orientation mentions.
Mixed-evidence ACs (repo verifiable + external outcome) now receive split coaching: code citations move to UNTAGGED criterion, external outcome keeps tag with required provenance: line.

Tagged ACs missing provenance: continuation lines are now rejected on close path (promotion from ADVISORY review-side lint) with re-review cycle documented to prevent post-certification retagging escape vectors.
